releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.10 — group calls. Starting a voice or video call from a group chat now opens the group call screen: the group avatar pulses inside a violet ring while 'Calling everyone in …' runs, then the call switches to the two-column participant grid — your own tile followed by everyone joining, each with a connecting badge until they are in, muted-mic markers and the name pills. The header shows how many people are in the call and a live timer, and the controls cover mute, camera on/off, speaker and the red hang-up, plus a Cancel button while it is still ringing.
